products.name: EBMX XLB-60 Motor
products.notes: Needs X-9000 controller + high-output battery. XLB-60 RACE (air-cooled): 50kW peak, 24kW continuous for 2m20s, 95KV, NJDC 605 encoder, 10-pole/12-slot dual-Y. EBMX lists Light Bee, Talaria XXX and E Ride Pro SS fitment (harness adapters required for Talaria XXX / E Ride Pro SS). Earlier research cited 42kW peak at 92V/1200A.

products.name: Sotion FW01 Motor
products.notes: FW01: 26 kW peak, 800A phase. Hall sensor for X-9000, encoder for Nucular.

products.name: EBMX XTA-60 Talaria Motor
products.notes: Needs EBMX X-9000 controller. 40 kW peak at 90V/1000A; 35 kW real-world on 72V. Designed for Talaria MX3/MX4; MX5 needs the EBMX XTA-60 MX5 adapter kit.

products.name: Sotion FW02 Talaria Motor
products.notes: Plug-and-play for MX4 (new gearbox bracket incl). Pairs with X-9000/Nucular/Torp.

products.name: VTB 41kW Ultra Bee Motor
products.notes: 48 kW peak with VTB V9600 controller (page title says 41 kW). Drop-in for Ultra Bee; 1100A phase; 11.8 kg.

products.name: VTB 28kW Light E-moto Motor
products.notes: Aftermarket controller required (VTB V9600 / Aetos Gen.2). 850A phase; 10.9 kg; 48-100V. Sold by TB Electric Moto as the Ventus 28 kW light e-moto motor.

products.name: Ventus Ryuga 81kW Motor
products.notes: Requires VTB AETOS V9600 controller for 81+ kW. 114 Nm. Direct plug-and-play for Ultra Bee.

products.name: Ventus Ryuga 52kW Motor
products.notes: Aftermarket VTB controller required. 91 Nm with V9600 + high-capacity battery. Out of stock at TB as of check.

products.name: TORP TM25 Motor
products.notes: 13kW continuous; peak 27kW @72V / 31kW @80V / 40kW @120V. 48-90V, 750A phase, 9.8kg, IP67, Hall + Encoder (1024) sensors. Requires aftermarket controller; needs TC500 HW v1.3+ if paired with a TC500. TORP official webshop lists EUR 811.25 incl. VAT.

products.name: TORP TM40 Pro Motor
products.notes: 50kW peak, 19kW continuous, 1100A phase, 86Nm, 12kg, IP67, 65mm magnets, Encoder (1024) or Hall. Verify sensor version against controller. So powerful a full bike upgrade (chain, sprocket, belt, brakes, high-discharge battery) is required.

products.name: Torp TM50 Off Road Torque Motor for Sur-Ron Ultra Bee
products.notes: Price verified $1,325, currently out of stock on all variants. Torque-focused variant on the shared TM50 page (58kW/102Nm class). Page explicitly states both Torp motors are built for the Ultra Bee.

products.name: Torp TM50 Pro High Top Speed Motor for Sur-Ron Ultra Bee
products.notes: Price verified $1,499 (corrected from $1,325 in research notes), currently out of stock. High-top-speed variant on the shared TM50 page.

products.name: Torp TM50 Speed Motor for Sur-Ron Ultra Bee
products.notes: Price verified $1,499 (corrected from $1,325), currently out of stock. Road/top-speed variant: 55kW peak, 89Nm, KV97 per page specs table.

products.name: E&Co Revolver Alpha 70H Motor
products.notes: Standalone Alpha 70H Revolver motor. E&Co support names it the recommended motor upgrade for the ETM RTR Sport; the Sport already has a 420 chain so no conversion kit is needed. 420 chain setup only. Out of stock at E&Co as of Nov 11, 2026.

products.name: E&Co High Speed Mod Motor
products.notes: Speed-focused mod motor for the ETM RTR Lite; up to 67 MPH on 72V when paired with the E&Co 13kW TruMoto 6+7 Mod Powertrain Kit. TBEM fitment lists the ETM RTR Lite.

products.name: E&Co High Torque Mod Motor
products.notes: Drop-in torque upgrade for the ETM RTR Lite on the stock controller; #35 chain only. Does not increase kW output — increases torque per amp. E&Co fitment lists the ETM RTR Lite.

products.name: E&Co Revolver Alpha Motor & 420 Chain Conversion Kit
products.notes: Alpha 70H Revolver motor + 420 chain conversion, bolts straight onto the 2025 ETM RTR or RTR Lite; works with the stock controller. $449 for 12in rear wheel, $469 for 14in rear wheel.

products.name: E-Conic Yozma IN10 Gear Reduction Motor
products.notes: Custom gear-reduction motor (2.37) with 420 14T sprocket for the Yozma IN10 / Valtinsu EM-5 / Tasaca V58. Spacers + washers supplied (70mm per mounting point). Recommended power at 72V: 150 line amps (~10.8 kW).
